blocks.p: This notice is for the people who sign in to the Pathways portal. It says what we hold about you, why, and for how long.

Parallel runs the portal with &go&co, our method partner, as one team, for your organisation and under our agreement with it. Your organisation decides who may sign in. To reach us about your data, ask the person at your organisation who invited you.
blocks.withContact: Parallel runs the portal with &go&co, our method partner, as one team, for your organisation and under our agreement with it. Your organisation decides who may sign in. To reach us about your data, write to {contact}.

ul: added at your organisation's request, with when and why you were added, by whom, and when your access ends. It's how you sign in, and how the portal knows you're allowed in.
when you sign in or fail to, and from which network address and country. Cloudflare Access, our sign-in service, keeps these.

blocks.p: Nothing else. There are no passwords, and no analytics, advertising or tracking.

Cloudflare Access sets only the cookies it needs to sign you in and keep you signed in, such as CF_Authorization. None are for analytics or advertising. A sign-in lasts up to 24 hours; then you sign in again.
The map also remembers a few display choices in your browser, such as the colour scale and how far you've got in How it works. They stay on your device and are never sent to us.

ul: To let only the people your organisation has approved in.
To keep the portal and your organisation's information secure, and to look into misuse.

blocks.p: We do this because we have a legitimate interest in keeping the portal secure, and to provide the service your organisation has asked us for. We don't use your data for anything else, and we don't sell it or share it with anyone else.

ul: Our team: Parallel and &go&co. Only Parallel's admins manage who can sign in.
Cloudflare, which runs the portal and its sign-in for us and stores your data in North America, under its data protection terms. It's listed under Services we use.

blocks.p: The portal runs no AI, and sends nothing about you to any AI service.

ul: Your portal account: until 12 months after the engagement ends, or sooner if your organisation asks.
Cloudflare's sign-in records: for a short period, under Cloudflare's terms.

blocks.p: You can ask to see, correct or delete what we hold about you, or object to or limit how we use it. Ask the person at your organisation who invited you. You can also complain to your data protection regulator: in the UK, the Information Commissioner's Office.
blocks.withContact: You can ask to see, correct or delete what we hold about you, or object to or limit how we use it. Write to {contact}, or ask the person at your organisation who invited you. You can also complain to your data protection regulator: in the UK, the Information Commissioner's Office.

blocks.p: If this notice changes, so does the date at the top.
